spec.title: Fix kanban-merge to mark task done BEFORE merging
spec.context: The kanban-merge skill currently updates task status to "done" after merging the branch into main, creating an extra commit on main. This pollutes git history with unnecessary commits after every merge.

scope.in-scope: - Reorder steps in kanban-merge skill to update status before merge - Ensure status commit is on task branch, not main
scope.out-of-scope: - Changes to other kanban skills - Changes to workflow transitions - Changes to commit message format

spec.requirements: - FR1: The system shall update task status to "done" while still on the task branch - FR2: The system shall commit the status change on the task branch before merging - FR3: The system shall merge the task branch into main after the status commit - FR4: The system shall not create any commits on main after the merge commit

patterns.pattern: Skill files use step-based XML process definitions with action, command, and note elements. Reference: apps/kanban/src/content/skills/kanban-merge/SKILL.md

research.product: - tasks/workflow: Defines pr → done transition as final workflow step
research.engineering: - Skill structure follows markdown with YAML frontmatter and XML process blocks - Commit format defined in .kanban/workflow.yaml: docs({id}): done - {title}
research.codebase: - Current step order: merge_branch (157-159) → cleanup_branch (163) → move_to_done_and_commit (166-173) - Steps are independent XML blocks that can be reordered
research.pitfalls: - Branch deletion must remain after merge (cannot delete branch we're merging from) - Status update must happen before checkout main (cannot commit on task branch after switching)

spec.constraints: - Must maintain --no-ff merge flag for branch history preservation - Must keep existing commit message format

risk.mitigation: Simple reorder with no logic changes

risks.risk: Reordering steps could introduce subtle bugs
